root_causes_identified.name: Window Title Bar Staging Masking
root_causes_identified.description: Dynamic menu action overwrites window title with static APP_TITLE, hiding [STAGING / AUDIT MODE] banner.

root_causes_identified.name: Expiry Date Format Misinterpretation in StockDAO
root_causes_identified.description: _is_expired and get_expiring split on '/' expecting MM/YY, failing silently on ISO YYYY-MM-DD stored batches (returns False for all 7,808 batches).

root_causes_identified.name: Zero-Stock Exclusion on Sales Returns
root_causes_identified.description: get_stock_batches_for_item filters stock_qty > 0, preventing selection of sold-out batches when accepting customer returns.

root_causes_identified.name: Party Balance Discrepancy (Opening Balance Omission)
root_causes_identified.description: get_customer_balance and get_supplier_balance omit account_ledgers.opening_balance, while ledger reports include it.

root_causes_identified.name: Non-Numeric Pack Size Rejection in pack_factor
root_causes_identified.description: float() conversion fails on packaging strings like 10'S, 1*10, 10TAB, causing factor to default to 1.0 instead of actual pack unit count.

root_causes_identified.name: Numeric Batch Numbers Perceived as Internal IDs
root_causes_identified.description: 1,042 of 7,808 batches are genuine manufacturer numbers that are purely numeric (e.g. '133', '1461'). Auto-popups made them appear like IDs.

root_causes_identified.name: Lexicographical Table Sorting on Formatted Monetary Values
root_causes_identified.description: String formatting in QTableWidgetItem causes alphabetical sort ('100.00' < '20.00') rather than numerical sort.

root_causes_identified.name: Target Primary Key vs Legacy ID Cognitive Divergence
root_causes_identified.description: Item Master displays target database ID (e.g. 946-1885) rather than source legacy ID (1-944), causing user confusion over item numbering.
